entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane where artifice is the basis of respect and every humanoid culture is entwined with creation.

entities.name: Metalcraft
entities.description: The Mirran reliance on artifice, also the ability word named in the column.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: A Mirran people whose weaponsmiths call themselves edgewrights and forge razorgrass into weapons.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Mirran humans of the Blade Tribe who gear up in threes before rushing into combat.

entities.name: Viridians
entities.description: Renegade elves of the Tangle who ride vorracs.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Mirran people who practice artifice more than any other race, shaping metal into mystical devices.

entities.name: Vorrac
entities.description: Beasts half boar, half appetite, ridden by the renegade Viridians.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Mirran fields where Auriok edgewrights scour for metallic razorgrass.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: A Mirran region whose steel rhinos and glint hawks threaten Auriok artificers.

entities.name: Mark Globus
entities.description: Designer whose brainstormed mechanic the placeholder name Presence was based on.

entities.name: Doug Beyer
entities.description: The column's author, on Magic's creative team, who brainstormed names for metalcraft.

entities.name: Joey MacArthur
entities.description: A real-world game industry conference attendee with a Platinum Angel tattoo.

events.summary: The creative team settles on the name metalcraft after a long brainstorm, having tested it with the team and the Pit.
events.quote: It took a long time to get here—sometimes you have to keep pounding away at something to find a good answer.

events.summary: Doug shares his brainstorm sheet of words considered for naming metalcraft.
events.quote: Today I'm going to show you my brainstorm sheet for metalcraft.

relations.note: the placeholder Presence was based on a mechanic he brainstormed
relations.quote: As I recall it was based on a mechanic brainstormed by Mark Globus.

relations.note: gather their favorite food and ride them
relations.quote: the renegade Viridians gather the vorracs' favorites before every ride.
